description: This file declares the SessionServerManager class, which implements the ISessionServerManager interface for managing session server lifecycle, configuration, and state transitions within the Rialto media server component. It includes method declarations for initialization, starting/stopping services, configuration, state management, and ping handling, along with private members for service dependencies and synchronization.

classes.name: SessionServerManager
classes.description: Implements session server management functionalities including initialization, configuration, state transitions, and service control within the Rialto media server.

methods.name: SessionServerManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for session server management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session server with command-line arguments.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with socket name, state, resource limits, display name, and permissions.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the session server.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets various debug log levels for different components.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Handles a ping request, possibly for health check.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Transitions the server to active state.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Transitions the server to inactive state.

methods.name: switchToNotRunning
methods.description: Transitions the server to not running state.
